title: He Taped A Fake Box In A Subway — Then Changed One Thing About His Voice
caption:
A man tapes an imaginary box onto a subway floor and asks strangers not to step in it. They walk straight through. Then he says the exact same thing in a lower, louder voice — and everyone starts apologizing. From "How To Improve Your Speaking And Vocal Projection".
